propositions: A new 1-TURN advisory LLM criterion ac-process-gate must be added to registry.CANONICAL_LLM to flag acceptance criteria whose entire completion predicate is a generic, ticket-agnostic mechanical process/tooling gate (children-closed, tests/CI/build/lint/typecheck pass, plan-review passes, completion-verifier passes, merged/landed, commit-trailer/DCO) that any ticket's verifier must satisfy regardless of subject.

The criterion must be registered with facet ac-text-quality, scope [container, leaf], default_posture advisory, and a two-key checklist (not-applicable when no ACs exist; judgment distinguishing generic gates from ticket-specific deliverables).

The rubric must document the litmus (would this AC read identically on an unrelated ticket?) and anti-false-positive rule (silence on any AC naming this ticket's specific deliverable, even if its subject is tests/CI/plan-review themselves).
A bounded-sanity eval corpus must be committed with at least two process-gate positive cases and two deliverable negative cases, achieving kappa=1.0 on live Bedrock execution.
The registry.chunk_by_facet packer must balance chunk sizes to avoid singleton trailing chunks, verified by parametrized regression tests for n=2..39.
